scope: Independent incremental F01 closure and affected public-gate compatibility review, binding the full initial control-maintenance scope.
scopeAssessment: The incremental commit changes only the gate, its existing test module, the missed-acceptance note and preserved R01. Original corrective_contract, backlog/spec schemas, product/reference behavior, ordinary/amendment authority and release criteria were not changed. R01's unchanged scope and source review are carried by its authenticated record; this round examined the new admission/discovery split and its directly affected no-UI path.

closedFindings.closure: Active campaign correction admissions are authenticated against their committed specs before mutable scope is used for inclusion. Both retained original fixtures now fail closed for empty and tests-only substituted scope, through the actual public automatic and explicit-short-base entry points. A genuinely admitted non-UI correction retains its parent fallback and passes without acquiring an unsupported UI review obligation.

proof.observations: Four public denial checks returned exit 1 with the exact spec-mismatch error; one existing legitimate non-UI compatibility test returned exit 0. Retained adverse fixtures and prior report remained unchanged.

findings.title: Narrowed no-UI inventory hides a correction-shaped record moved outside the campaign
findings.criterion: The full public gate must reject a substituted correction identity/admission and cannot let an explicit shortened range conceal uncontracted UI. Existing ordinary-masquerade denials and whole-task-base authority must survive the F01 remedy.
findings.incrementalReason: R02 replaces the no-UI branch's backlog_tasks inventory with authenticated_active_corrections, which enumerates only campaign.corrective_tasks. This drops the earlier detection of correction-shaped records placed among ordinary tasks. It is a direct compatibility consequence of the F01 change, not a reopened speculative product audit.
reproduction: Create one owned synthetic linked UI correction fixture with its immutable spec and full admission base.
Commit a real governed UI change without its required UI contract.
Move the unchanged active correction record from campaign.corrective_tasks into the ordinary task list in a later evidence-only commit.
Run the actual public gate with an explicit base equal to the UI commit, making the selected range evidence-only.
findings.observed: Explicit shortened no-UI validation returned exit 0 and ok=true with no contract. Automatic public validation rejected the same fixture with 'linked correction must be an admitted campaign corrective task'; the full admitted-base public command rejected its missing UI contract.
findings.expected: The explicit public no-UI path rejects the unsupported correction placement before the early return, consistently with automatic mode and the prior broader inventory check.
findings.impact: A public whole-task-base UI check can report a false PASS despite an earlier uncontracted UI implementation. This finding does not claim that taskctl submission, independent review or release authority was bypassed.
findings.smallestClosure: Preserve detection of active correction-shaped records in the broader task inventory while authenticating genuine campaign admissions before scope filtering. Require actual campaign membership for any candidate correction record. Add the exact explicit-public-no-UI masquerade regression; retain automatic denial, original F01 denials and genuinely admitted non-UI compatibility. No new controller, approval metadata, corrective-contract mutation or unrelated audit is required.
